title: Agmon et al. — Vivarium: an interface and engine for integrative multiscale modeling in computational biology
scope: Processes, stores, multirate composition, and integrated example models.
limitation: Does not establish a universal sufficient cell state or the correctness of arbitrary coupled modules.

title: Sluka et al. — The cell behavior ontology: describing the intrinsic biological behaviors of real and model cells seen as active agents
scope: Biological semantics separable from implementation terminology.
limitation: An ontology does not define complete numerical restart or constitutive state.

title: Friedman et al. — MultiCellDS: a community-developed standard for curating microenvironment-dependent multicellular data
scope: Digital cell lines, snapshots, phenotype and microenvironment data.
limitation: The cited publication is bioRxiv; it is not proof of lossless universal solver interoperability.

title: Ghaffarizadeh et al. — PhysiCell: An open source physics-based cell simulator for 3-D multicellular systems
scope: Cell agents coupled to substrates; distinct diffusion, mechanics, phenotype time scales.
limitation: Its defaults, convergence and performance do not transfer to the supplied toy scaffold.

title: preCICE — Overview of adapters
scope: Lists official and third-party adapters.
limitation: SOFA, ESPResSo and Tissue Forge are not listed; this is not an exhaustive proof no outside adapter exists.

title: preCICE — Step 6: Implicit coupling
scope: Iterative coupling requires solver checkpoint/restore and reproducible evaluation.
limitation: preCICE does not implement the participating solver checkpoint internals.

title: preCICE — Mapping configuration
scope: Consistent, conservative and scaled-consistent mappings.
limitation: Global sum preservation is not by itself energy, torque, local flux or biological validity.

title: Smith et al. — Verification and reproducible curation of the BioModels repository
scope: 932 of 1055 ODE models agreed across at least two of five engines; published 2025-12-04.
limitation: Many experiments use generic templates; not all original figures were reproduced. Not a spatial biological-validation study.

title: FDA — Assessing the Credibility of Computational Modeling and Simulation in Medical Device Submissions
access: full PDF text and scope-page screenshot, section III printed page 7
scope: Risk- and context-dependent credibility framework for first-principles/mechanistic models.
limitation: Standalone ML is excluded; hybrid-model guidance covers first-principles aspects only. No approval of this architecture.

title: Tatka et al. — Adapting modeling and simulation credibility standards to computational systems biology
scope: Proposes adaptation of credibility practices to systems biology.
limitation: Proposal/review, not a validation experiment or issued regulatory standard.

title: Sajjadinia et al. — Multi-fidelity surrogate modeling through hybrid machine learning for biomechanical and finite element analysis of soft tissues
access: author-institution abstract and bibliographic record; publisher full text inaccessible in this audit
scope: Empirical reduced-physics plus learned correction for expensive soft-tissue FE models.
limitation: Not a proof of online tumor-solver switching or experimentally calibrated cancer predictions; no quantitative gains adopted here.

title: Kim, Stolarska and Othmer — A hybrid model for tumor spheroid growth in vitro I: Theoretical development and early results
scope: Cell-level growing periphery, continuum quiescent/necrotic regions and ECM, nutrient fields.
limitation: Prior art for regional model heterogeneity; not the exact proposed heterogeneous-engine controller.

title: Agmon and Spangler — Process Bigraphs and the Architecture of Compositional Systems Biology
access: abstract and version history; v2 dated 2026-08-14
scope: Typed interfaces, hierarchy, model translation and coordination, Vivarium 2.0 demonstrations.
limitation: Preprint; no peer-reviewed journal status confirmed. Closely related prior art, not a proof of this design.

title: Ascheid et al. — A vascularized breast cancer spheroid platform for the ranked evaluation of tumor microenvironment-targeted drugs by light sheet fluorescence microscopy
access: full text including model construction and results
scope: Four human-origin populations, pseudovascular organization, imaging/drug-response phenotypes, and additional in-vivo vascular comparisons.
limitation: The in-vitro spheroid arm does not demonstrate intravascular perfusion. The paper also contains in-vivo perfused-vessel measurements; these must not be confused with spheroid perfusion.

title: Quintard et al. — A microfluidic platform integrating functional vascularized organoids-on-chip
scope: Functional perfusion of mesenchymal/pancreatic-islet spheroids and blood-vessel organoids.
limitation: Not a cancer-treatment validation dataset; useful vascular-engineering precedent.

title: Skubal et al. — Vascularized tumor on a microfluidic chip to study mechanisms promoting tumor neovascularization and vascular targeted therapies
scope: Metastatic renal-cell-carcinoma chip with vessel sprouting, bead and fluorescein experiments.
limitation: Figure 3 bead perfusion n=1 chip and fluorescein n=4; tracer transport and beads are not actual drug PK or deformable blood cells.

title: Wang et al. — Calibration of agent based models for monophasic and biphasic tumour growth using approximate Bayesian computation
scope: SMC-ABC parameter inference for a 2D Voronoi ABM using mouse xenograft data.
limitation: No cell death; declining late measurements excluded for model-assumption compatibility; breast-labeled MDA-MB435 data require authentication qualification.

title: Cellosaurus — MDA-MB-435 (CVCL_0417)
scope: Lists MDA-MB-435 as an M14 derivative and registered misidentified cell line.
limitation: A resource-level identity warning does not retrospectively assay the exact historical vial used in an experiment.

title: SBML specifications
scope: Software-independent biological model descriptions and level/package distinctions.
limitation: A file format alone does not establish every solver supports each package or arbitrary dynamic cell geometry.

title: SED-ML — Simulation Experiment Description Markup Language
scope: Model modifications, simulation procedures, outputs and experiment exchange.
limitation: The proposed ABM/coupling experiment requires explicit supported mappings; schema existence is not runtime conformance.

title: Bergmann et al. — COMBINE archive and OMEX format: one file to share all information to reproduce a modeling project
scope: ZIP-based archive with mandatory manifest and optional metadata; can include additional formats.
limitation: Packaging custom files does not make their semantics executable by independent solvers.

title: SOFA — Features
scope: FEM, nonlinear material options, contact and representation mappings.
limitation: Capability documentation is not cancer-cell material calibration or a biological accuracy ranking.

title: ESPResSo — Object-in-Fluid
scope: Triangulated elastic objects with stretching, bending, area and volume forces in fluid.
limitation: Cell-like mechanics does not itself validate tumor-cell/nuclear constitutive behavior.

title: Tissue Forge — Vertex Model Solver
scope: Surface/body representation and actor-based mechanics.
limitation: Automatic mesh-quality operations are primarily developed for two-dimensional use; not all 3D dynamic-topology behavior can be presumed.

title: NVIDIA Warp — Documentation
scope: CPU/CUDA kernels, geometry/numerical primitives and differentiability.
limitation: Does not establish biological credibility, comparative speed on this workload, or differentiability of arbitrary discrete events.

title: Bull et al. — Mathematical modelling reveals cellular dynamics within tumour spheroids
access: full text, model and oxygen sections
scope: Off-lattice cell model with continuous quasi-steady oxygen and comparison to spheroid-infiltration experiments.
limitation: Reported simulations restricted to 2D; conditional model assumptions, not general 3D perfused-tumor validation.

title: Murphy et al. — Growth and adaptation mechanisms of tumour spheroids with time-dependent oxygen availability
access: full text including cell culture methods
scope: Time-dependent oxygen spheroid experiments and growth/adaptation modeling; authenticated melanoma cell lines.
limitation: Provides scoped observables; does not validate the proposed software without matched experiments and held-out predictions.

title: Waltemath et al. — Minimum Information About a Simulation Experiment (MIASE)
scope: Information needed to reproduce model setup, execution and postprocessing.
limitation: Documentation completeness is necessary but not empirical biological accuracy.

title: Stöberl et al. — Nuclear deformation and dynamics of migrating cells in 3D confinement reveal adaptation of pulling and pushing forces
access: author-institution abstract and bibliographic record; PMC full text blocked
scope: Nuclear shapes, displacement-derived forces and migration dynamics in compliant three-dimensional hydrogel channels.
limitation: Supports a confinement-specific mechanics benchmark, not universal strain thresholds or complete cancer-cell constitutive laws.

title: Bastianello et al. — Mechanical stress during confined migration causes aberrant mitoses and c-MYC amplification
access: author-institution full PDF; abstract, results and methods inspected; no numerical figure data digitized
scope: Microfluidic confinement, live imaging and molecular observations connect mitotic confinement with chromosome-segregation defects and oncogenic alterations in studied systems.
limitation: Does not supply a universal deformation-to-mutation equation or validate the proposed simulator.
